title_sub: Europa League · Thursday 15 October · Lagos time
title_say: Postcards from Europe. Five Europa League ties, one postcard from each host city.

say: Lisbon, nineteen sixty-seven.
Tonight, Celtic go back.
Pierre Sage returns to Lyon, with the Conference League holders.
And Marseille lost four in a row in September.

steps.label: Celtic win the European Cup · in Lisbon
Marseille defeats in a row · September

say: First, Lyon, at a quarter to six. Pierre Sage coached here until January last year, and now he brings Crystal Palace.
Palace are without Mateta, and have only one win in their last eight away games. Lyon are without Openda.
Our numbers: Lyon thirty-nine percent, Palace thirty-three.
Our call: Lyon don't lose.
notes: No Mateta for Palace, no Openda for Lyon
Palace: 1 win in their last 8 away
lyon-crystal-palace.credit: Groupama Stadium, Lyon · Photo: Alexis Klein · CC BY-SA 4.0  ·  Keito Nakamura · Photo: Werner100359 · CC BY-SA 4.0  ·  Jørgen Strand Larsen · Photo: Bryan Berlin · CC BY-SA 4.0

say: Same time, in Salzburg: unbeaten in fifteen games.
Milan lost at home to Benfica on matchday one, and eighteen-year-old Camarda is expected to start.
Our numbers have Milan at forty-nine percent.
Our call: Milan don't lose.
notes: Milan lost 2–0 at home to Benfica
Camarda, 18, set for a first start
salzburg-ac-milan.credit: Red Bull Arena, Salzburg · Photo: Arne Müseler · CC BY-SA 3.0 de  ·  Haris Tabaković · Photo: Werner100359 · CC BY-SA 4.0  ·  Adrien Rabiot · Photo: Bryan Berlin · CC BY-SA 4.0

say: Eight o'clock, Vigo, and Iago Aspas is back after a month out.
Juventus are missing Yildiz, Locatelli and Thuram, but have kept four clean sheets in a row in Europe.
Our numbers: Juventus thirty-nine, Celta thirty-two.
Our call: Juventus don't lose.
notes: Aspas back after a month out
4 European clean sheets in a row
celta-juventus.credit: Abanca-Balaídos, Vigo · Photo: Jsmq · CC BY 3.0  ·  Iago Aspas · Photo: Harpagornis · CC BY-SA 4.0  ·  Francisco Conceição · Photo: Bryan Berlin · CC BY-SA 4.0

say: Marseille: thirteenth in Ligue 1, and beaten four–one in Istanbul on matchday one.
Olympiacos have four wins in their last five, the derby included. No away fans are expected.
Our call: Olympiacos don't lose.
notes: OM lost 4 in a row in September
marseille-olympiacos.credit: Stade Vélodrome, Marseille · Photo: Bernard Ddd · CC BY-SA 2.0  ·  Amine Gouiri · Photo: Supporterhéninois

say: And the last postcard: Lisbon, where Celtic won the European Cup in nineteen sixty-seven.
Benfica beat Milan, two–nil, at San Siro. Celtic lost at home to Ferencváros, and Carter-Vickers is out.
Our numbers: Benfica sixty-eight percent.
Our call: a Benfica win.
notes: Celtic won the European Cup here in 1967
benfica-celtic.credit: Estádio da Luz, Lisbon · Photo: Massimo Catarinella · CC BY 3.0  ·  Vangelis Pavlidis · Photo: Carlo Bruil Fotografie · CC BY 2.0  ·  Callum McGregor · Photo: Hameltion · CC BY-SA 4.0

say: The rest of the Europa League, pinned up.
Sparta Prague bring five straight wins. Beşiktaş, who beat Marseille, visit Hoffenheim.
And Torreense, from Portugal's second tier, host Sunderland in Leiria.

cards.note: Jagiellonia: lost four in a row

say: It's also opening night in the Conference League.
Ajax go to Hajduk Split without Dolberg, and Getafe are back in Europe after six years.

cards.note: Getafe: first European trip in six years
PAO lost the derby last time out
Brighton: four wins in a row
Braga lost to Sporting last time

end_say: Five postcards, five calls. Follow for the results after full time.
